description:
🚀 Join Our NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Team!

We're looking for passionate and creative teammates to collaborate, innovate, and build something impactful using NASA's open data.

Interested in AI/ML, software development, UI/UX, data science, GIS, research, or DevOps? We'd love to have you on board!

No need to be an expert — just bring your ideas, enthusiasm, and teamwork spirit. Let's build something amazing together! 🌍
